scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('backend/dist','dist',{recursive:true})"
